changes: Every class now learns three new spec-themed abilities between levels 11 and 15.
Added a third talent row from level 20 with one talent per tree that improves these abilities.

Hunter: Mongoose Bite has a shorter cooldown, deals more damage and empowers your next Raptor Strike by 45%. Several talents were strengthened, and the Raptor Strike and Serpent Sting talents now add damage.
Mage: reduced Arcane damage. Arcane Missiles, Evocation, Arcane Instability and Improved Arcane Missiles are weaker.
Druid: Bear Form and Cat Form talents are now available from level 12.
Warrior: the Execute cooldown talent now reduces the cooldown by 20 seconds per rank.
Default loadouts now always keep your main no-cooldown attack, and ability tooltips describe debuffs, retaliation damage and pet bonuses.
The combat meter now also counts healing from lifesteal, Smite, Critical Heal and potions.
Added profession bonuses: rare drops from combat zones that improve skill-up chance, speed or double-item chance. Equip them account-wide in 3 slots per profession.
Crafting and disenchanting now run through one account-wide crafting queue. It survives character switches, is saved, and runs while the professions menu is open.
Blacksmithing recipes no longer need stone. Each reagent amount is 1 higher instead.
Combat zones now show which profession bonuses drop there and which ones you have found.
The Changelog page now groups changes by category.
Switching characters in the profession windows no longer changes your played character once you leave them.
The Ability Loadout now lists talent abilities you haven't learned yet under Coming Up, including which talent unlocks them and what it requires.
New crafting materials now go to bags 1 and 3 first, consumables to bags 2 and 4. Existing stacks are always topped up before a new slot is used.
Added craftable level 10 gear (hands, belt, feet) for Tailoring, Leatherworking and Blacksmithing.
Crafting and disenchanting skill-up chance now rises by 0.2% per 10 levels across all your characters.
The profession trainer window now keeps a fixed size, so the Train button no longer moves when you select a recipe.
The sidebar now shows a travel countdown while you are on other pages. Click it to return to the travel scene.
The game now reopens the page you were on when you last closed it.
Added hotkeys: B or C opens the Inventory, F the Idle Fighter, K Professions and N Talents.
Added a Changelog page to the menu that shows what changed in each build.
From level 10, each death costs 5% of your current XP. You never lose a level.
Current health and mana, rage or energy are now saved and restored on load.
The new ability popup in Idle Fighter now stays until you dismiss it. The × closes it without equipping the ability.
Fixed misplaced and see-through tooltips on upcoming abilities in the Ability Loadout.
Elixirs and buff food now last 3 minutes instead of 1.
Fixed dragging characters into zone slots on Linux.
Consumables can be toggled on the combat bar with a right-click.
Health and mana potions now have separate cooldowns.
Gathering professions: passive runs take 90 seconds instead of 120, and skill-ups only come from passive gathering.
Professions are now unlocked in the menu for the whole account.
Updates are now checked every minute while playing, and the game saves before restarting.
Items can be moved between inventory slots and bags with drag & drop.
Travel now continues while you are on other pages.
